description: This PHP class 'OAuthServer' sets up and manages an OAuth 2.0 authorization server, including configuration, grant types, and token TTLs, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: A class that initializes and manages an OAuth 2.0 authorization server, including grant types and token expiration settings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration and repositories for the OAuth server.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the configured AuthorizationServer instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL (time-to-live) for authorization codes.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for access tokens.
